title: Psalm 23 — The Lord Is My Shepherd
description: A Back to the Bible study on God's care and guidance, with discussion questions for cell fellowship.
author: ROLCC Fellowship Team

sections.heading: Observe
sections.body: Read Psalm 23 aloud. What images does David use to describe God's care?

sections.heading: Interpret
sections.body: David portrays God as a shepherd who provides, guides, protects, and restores.

sections.heading: Apply
sections.body: What valley are you walking through right now? How can you trust the Shepherd's presence?

discussionQuestions: Which phrase in Psalm 23 speaks most to you today?
How have you experienced God's provision or guidance recently?

quiz.question: How does David describe the Lord in Psalm 23?
quiz.explanation: The opening verse says, 'The Lord is my shepherd.'

quiz.question: What does the shepherd provide according to this psalm?
options: Victory over every enemy by force
quiz.explanation: David portrays God as caring for every need of the sheep.

quiz.question: What image helps us trust God in hard seasons?
options: Walking through the valley with the Shepherd present
Relying only on our own strength
quiz.explanation: The psalm promises the Shepherd's presence in the valley.
